setting cash money = 0 "Cash and bank"
setting gold num = 0 "Gold (grams)"
setting debts money = 0 "Debts due now"
setting gold_rate money = 0 "Gold price per gram"
setting silver money = 0 "Silver (grams)"
setting debts_total money = 0 "Total debts"
setting silver_rate money = 0 "Silver price per gram"
setting gold_grams num = 0 "Gold (grams)"

state silvermoney num = 0
state goldmin money = 0
state debtsmin money = 0
state rate money = 0
state gramsmin num = 0
state silvermin money = 0
state debts_total money = 0

  field gold
  field silver
  field gold_grams
  field debts_done
  field silvermin
  field debts_total

  "Silver" round(min(wealth * 0.025, 1000) * 1000) / 1000 faint

state left dur = 300s

  circle 50, 50, if(going, bad, good) + 3 fill if(going, accent, soft)
  circle 50, 50, if(going, left, soft) + 3 fill if(going, bad, good) + 3
left big
